about.title: About me
about.text: I am a Full-Stack Developer based in Leipzig, Germany. After a decade in logistics I went back to school, earned a Master's in Medical Physics and first got into programming with Python for data analysis. For the past two years I have been working as a developer full time, and alongside that I build websites for businesses end to end, from front-end to back-end.
about.contactMe: If you think I would be a good match for your project, get in touch.

offcode.title: Off the keyboard
offcode.intro: A few things about me that are not in the CV.

climbing.label: Climbing & bouldering
climbing.title: Four years in
climbing.text: Indoors and on rock. In Leipzig at Bloc, Onyx, No Limit and the Mockauer Turm, outdoors in Löbejün and the Saxon Switzerland. Lead up to 7+ (UIAA), boulders up to 5.

music.label: Music
music.title: Drums with Empty Handed
music.text: For a few years, not active any more. One video is still around.

sport.label: Sport
sport.title: Climbing is the main sport
sport.text: Plus the gym two or three times a week and the occasional padel match. Before that, 19 years of football.

hours.label: Working hours
hours.title: Often late
hours.text: Evenings are quiet. That is when I concentrate best, so that is when I work.

before.label: Before
before.title: Logistics, then medical physics
before.text: Ten years in logistics, then the Master's. I wrote my thesis at Positrigo, a startup building a PET scanner dedicated to brain imaging (NeuroLF). I ran and evaluated the NEMA measurements there.

drive.label: Path
drive.title: Ambitious
drive.text: What I start, I finish. The path surprises most people: lower secondary school, later a Master's in Medical Physics, today a full-time software developer. The job I wanted.

skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: The position says enough. What I use every day sits at the top.

services.title: What I offer
services.intro: From a polished landing page to a full web app. I build the whole thing, and I build it properly.

card1.title: Modern websites
card1.text: Fast, responsive websites that are GDPR-compliant, accessible (WCAG) and meet today's web standards. They look sharp on every device.

card2.title: Full-stack web apps
card2.text: Custom software built end to end: Angular or React on the front, solid APIs and databases on the back. Whatever your product needs.

card3.title: Code & consulting
card3.text: Reviews for performance, accessibility and code quality, plus ongoing maintenance to keep your existing site fast, secure and up to date.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: What I build alongside client work.

webwerk.label: Co-founder
webwerk.title: Webwerk Leipzig
webwerk.text: The two of us build fast, well-made websites for businesses in Leipzig, personal and local.

traudel.label: Co-founder, in progress
traudel.title: traudel.app
traudel.text: Being neighbours means more than living next to each other. Traudel brings neighbours back together: help, honest recommendations, lending. Runs in the browser and on the phone.
traudel.status: Not public yet. More once it launches.
